name: silent-saves
summary: Repeated execution under change: 100 runs of one task. The schedule switches one UI change on for each block of items, then off again, and puts four server faults on fixed items.
schedule: independent: each block has only its own change, so a change that stops an executor does not hide the blocks after it

task.instruction: Open Jane Sample's referral, start a Triage encounter, and save this note: {note}
task.note: Synthetic follow-up note {item}: recheck in {days} days

page.why: The page sends MockMed's demo idempotency key, as scoreboard arms 1 to 3 ran. 1.0.0's duplicate fault needs no key, so it is not in this set.

rename.what: Save Encounter becomes Submit Encounter; Open becomes View

move.what: the form's action buttons move to the other side

notice.what: a What's New interstitial replaces the task list until dismissed

sort.what: the referral queue is sorted by name; Jane Sample is no longer first

relink.what: New Encounter becomes Start visit, with a new id, on the other side of the screen

lookalike.what: a new referral with the same reason and priority as Jane Sample's appears directly above hers

typelabel.what: Triage is relabeled Triage Assessment and swaps places with Consult

missing.what: Jane Sample's referral is gone; the others remain

not_used.modal-once: MockMed's survey modal is skipped on the fault server's save path (app.js handles ?fault before its modal drifts), so it would never show. The new-screen case is the notice interstitial.

trap_note: A trap is a change where acting on the old screen positions writes the wrong record: another patient, or a Consult instead of a Triage. Under missing, no correct save exists, so the right answer is to stop.
fault_note: Server faults from fault set 1.0.0, one per item, on items in benign blocks. They measure detection.
duplicate_note: The page sends a save key in 1.1.0, so MockMed's own duplicate (the page sends twice; the server drops the second send by key) would be a clean save. At item 60 the proxy instead sends the save to the server twice without the key, so two rows land, as when a server processes one request twice.
